commitments.detail: Thermocouple recalibration (2 hours) must be completed before any batch run begins on Furnace 7.
Failed gas analyzer must be replaced with the available spare before any heat-treatment run can begin. Process safety sign-off contingent on confirmed replacement.
Batch R runs first in the sequence to ensure its staged alloy charge does not exceed the 4-hour oxidation limit at the furnace bay.
Batch Q requires 15 first-piece hardness tests to be completed and reviewed before batch Q is released. Q is sequenced second so these tests can proceed while R is running and before P begins.
